method.interpretation: Codex researched and wrote this report from primary sources, with external trend pages used only for discovery.
method.github_stars: No synchronized week-start/week-end snapshots were retained; weekly star deltas are intentionally omitted.
method.arxiv: Selected by first submission date in the reporting interval.
method.hugging_face_papers: No archived daily leaderboard snapshots for this interval; no HF ranking claims are made.
method.cann: Only dated releases and explicit model/framework support statements count as confirmed support.

signals.title: DeepSeek dsh-superagent research prototype
signals.summary: Repository-scoped proactive coding agent with isolated work sessions, GitHub/optional Feishu intake, PR delivery, and a human review panel. README says research prototype only, not official product or production-ready.

signals.title: Codex CLI 0.167.0
signals.summary: Adds terminal agent command center and unread-result indicators in the session picker; supports connected backend switching while retaining drafts.

signals.title: agent-desktop v1.2.0
signals.summary: Adds MCP support and desktop interaction improvements; interface is based on operating-system accessibility trees rather than screenshot coordinates.

signals.title: Datasette Agent 0.5a0 and Datasette Apps 0.3a0
signals.summary: Adds an agent-side panel for Datasette pages and apps; write-query access requires user approval.

signals.title: Predictive Safety Guardrails Do Not Always Make LLM Agents Safer
signals.summary: Reports that stronger predictive-guardrail involvement did not monotonically improve safety, and could reduce task completion while raising inference cost across tested models/environments.

signals.title: LUCA: A Synthetic World for Experimental Reasoning
signals.summary: Introduces controlled synthetic-world evaluation; reports that successful interventions may coexist with incorrect diagnosis and that more exploration is not reliably better.

signals.title: Strategist: Evolving Reasoning with Agents
signals.summary: Uses a meta-agent to produce reusable inference-strategy blueprints; authors report results across 30 benchmarks and lower inference cost, subject to their evaluation protocol.

signals.title: When Strong Reasoners Join the Pool: Small Union Premiums and Costly Runaway Generations in LLM Routing
signals.summary: Measures small empirical union premiums under a fixed protocol and highlights long generations' cost; the author cautions against direct comparison because pools and protocols differ.

signals.title: No verified W45 formal release or new-model first-support announcement found
signals.summary: vLLM Ascend v0.30.0 and Triton-Ascend 3.6.0.post2 were October 29 W44 releases; repository issue/PR activity alone is not treated as a release or deployable model support.
